_comment: CHORD dish grid + element mapping (KV, 2026-08-29). THE REFERENCE for #102.
GRID CONVENTION: dishes on a grid, nominally perfect EW rows / NS columns.
- EW rows are LETTERS: A at the SOUTHERN end, B north of it, ... rows 8.5 m apart
(a C element is 8.5 m north of a B element).
- NS columns are NUMBERS: 01 at the WESTERN end, 02 east of it, ... columns 6.3 m
apart (B01 is 6.3 m west of B02).
- Feeds are linear: x aligned EW, y aligned NS, polarizations coincident.
ENU here: E = (column-1)*6.3, N = (row_letter-A)*8.5, U = 0, relative to A01.
MAPPING STATUS: correlator element index -> name as KV believes it stands
2026-08-29 ('I don't have perfect clarity') -- interleaved columns 1,5,2,6,3,7,4,8,
pairs (2k, 2k+1) = (X, Y) of one dish; elements 16-31 repeat with row B.
VALIDATION: fixtures/elem_mapping_check.py scores each element's measured
comb-amplitude pattern (elem archive) against every nominal position; the
assignment should reproduce this table. Re-run whenever cabling changes.
